candidates.change_summary: Delete the 'depositsCount++' statement so the deposit counter is never incremented.
Replace the increment with 'depositsCount += 2' so each deposit adds two instead of one.
Replace the overflow guard with 'require(depositsCount < 2)' so only the first two deposits succeed.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can drain the contract balance.
Change withdrawAll to transfer zero value instead of the full balance.
Change the onlyOwner check from equality to inequality so the modifier reverts for the owner and passes for everyone else.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner so it imposes no restriction.
Replace the transferred amount `_value` with `address(this).balance`, so the transfer amount no longer matches the requested `_value`.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner)` check so the modifier imposes no restriction, letting any address call `withdraw`.
Invert the ownership check to `msg.sender != owner`, so the owner is now blocked while non-owners are allowed.

Change the transfer target from `msg.sender` to `owner`, so funds can go to a different address when the caller is not the owner (e.g. via `sendMoney`-style reentry contexts) and observable outcomes differ.
